scope: Local Debug filesystem measurements on verified deterministic real Parquet files; exact answers agree. Native compilation and lifecycle tests overlapped some measurements.
sort_counter_scope: Decorated sort candidates and native ordered row probes; excludes membership construction, planning and other query I/O.
conclusion: Ordered top-20 decorates 21 candidates and probes 37 ordered rows instead of decorating 16384 candidates. Excluding a declared unindexed payload reduces newly retained refresh artifact bytes by about 85%. Timing is observational.
